localPatches.title: Preserve FX context in cached portfolio snapshots
Integrate activity taxes into Unified Cash Ledger movements
localPatches.description: Correctly accounts for taxes and fees exactly once, handles tax-only edits, and preserves tax data during JSON portfolio restoration. Applies to the Ghostfolio-NG integration of upstream PRs [#8252](https://github.com/ghostfolio/ghostfolio/pull/8252) and [#8305](https://github.com/ghostfolio/ghostfolio/pull/8305).

localPatches.title: Replace existing portfolio data from a JSON backup
localPatches.description: Adds transactional portfolio replacement with deletion preview, explicit confirmation, rollback on failure, preservation of personal settings and historical manual asset data, and a user guide localized in 13 languages. Developed independently in Ghostfolio-NG [PR #10](https://github.com/piggei/ghostfolio/pull/10).

localPatches.title: Enhance ETF country and sector composition from issuer data
localPatches.description: Adds issuer-specific ETF composition enhancers for selected iShares, Vanguard, and Xtrackers funds, with country and sector normalization, coverage validation, and preservation of unclassified exposures. The shared normalizer is proposed separately in upstream PR #8469.
